purpose: Resolve ambiguity between Claude audit random-family control and raw-history nonempty split protocol.

claude_reported_control.statement: arbitrary split of 287 randomly chosen families, seeds 1–5 -> 2083 groups, rank 1144 x5
claude_reported_control.reconstruction_status: UNDER-SPECIFIED IN REPORT: selection universe and within-family split rule are not defined precisely enough to reproduce uniquely.

A_random_287_grid_families_random_nonemp.definition: Choose 287 of the 1796 grid families uniformly without replacement. Within every chosen family, randomly partition its raw-history members into two nonempty subsets. Unchosen families remain intact.
A_random_287_grid_families_random_nonemp.verdict: Does NOT reproduce Claude's 1144 result; gives full rank in all five seeds.

B_same_287_epsilon_splittable_family_set.definition: Use exactly the 287 grid families on which epsilon varies, but replace epsilon labels by an arbitrary random nonempty raw-history split.
B_same_287_epsilon_splittable_family_set.verdict: Matches Claude's qualitative conclusion that arbitrary labels on the epsilon-selected family SET remain full rank.

C_random_287_grid_families_use_epsilon_a.definition: Choose 287 random grid families but split only according to the actual epsilon bit. Families where epsilon is constant do not actually split.
C_random_287_grid_families_use_epsilon_a.verdict: Also does not match the reported 2083-group control; actual group count is much lower.

conclusion: The natural raw-history interpretation of 'arbitrary split of 287 randomly chosen families' gives full rank, not 1144.
The Claude report does not provide enough protocol detail to identify why its control remained rank 1144.
Do not treat either protocol as a theorem about random refinement. Preserve the discrepancy as an audit item unless the original control code is supplied.
Independent of this ambiguity, exact grid rank 1144 and exact 15/16 anchor-policy ranks remain valid.
